EAP-1 Protocol

Email Agent Protocol — the wire format for inter-organism communication.

Required Headers

X-EAP-Version: 1.0
X-EAP-Sender-Type: system
X-EAP-Intent: report

Optional Headers

X-EAP-Sender-ID: SIEM-Agent-001
X-EAP-Org: BigCo Security
X-EAP-Priority: high
X-EAP-Thread-ID: 7f3a2c91-...
X-EAP-Payload-Type: json
X-EAP-Schema: probe-report
X-EAP-Signature: hmac-sha256-...
X-EAP-Billing: ssn-x-0x...

Example: Security → Membrane

From: security@bigco.com
To: membrane@medinatechlabs.net
Subject: Daily probe summary for our edge
X-EAP-Version: 1.0
X-EAP-Sender-Type: system
X-EAP-Intent: report
X-EAP-Schema: probe-report
X-EAP-Payload-Type: json

{
  "source": "bigco-edge-firewall",
  "timeframe": "2026-05-21T00:00:00Z/P1D",
  "probes": [
    {"ip": "45.88.138.44", "path": "/wp-login.php", "ua": "nuclei"},
    {"ip": "203.159.90.116", "path": "/.env", "ua": "python-requests"}
  ],
  "summary_requested": true
}
